subject: Qual -> POC handshake: CedarLane pilot scope & kickoff actions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cedarlane.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cedarlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qual -> POC handshake: CedarLane pilot scope & kickoff actions

Hi Sanjay / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clean handoff into pilot planning. I kept this intentionally short and action-focused.

Pain points you confirmed
- High rate of false positives in triage assistant (manual review backlog).
- Latency spikes during peak hours causing degraded throughput for care coordinators.
- Need predictable per-request cost to justify expanding to other lines of business.

Pilot / success hypothesis
We propose a 3-week POC that demonstrates:
1) 30% reduction in manual review volume on the triage set (primary metric).
2) Average response latency < 300ms p99 for the evaluated prompts at target concurrency.
3) Token cost per 1k requests within the budget threshold you set ($0.XX).

Scope & deliverables
- Prompt set: 250 representative triage prompts (we'll use your sample + synthetic augmentation).
- Eval plan: precision/recall on labeled sample, latency/throughput traces, cost per 1k tokens.
- Owners: CedarLane product (Sanjay) + ops (Priya) + Redwood CS (Marissa) + Redwood infra lead (Ben).
- Access: SSO (SAML) for CedarLane testers; API key scoped to the pilot project.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): security questionnaire + sample data + SSO details due.
- Week 1: environment setup, prompt upload, baseline eval.
- Week 2: iterative tuning, monitoring dashboards, perf tests.
- Week 3: final eval, readout, and next-step recommendation.

Immediate asks for CedarLane
- Send the sample data schema and 250 de-identified prompts (sample-data-schema.csv recommended) — Priya, can you confirm by Friday?
- Provide SSO metadata for SAML integration (IDP metadata XML) or confirm you want API-key-based access for the pilot.
- A single technical point of contact we can add to the pilot Drive folder.

Attachments: cedarlane-success-metrics.xlsx (success metric template), sample-data-schema.csv (schema stub).

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with the engineering owners and provision the pilot workspace. Thanks —

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

---
Redwood Inference — small note: we will default to a dedicated pilot project in our hosted environment unless you request VPC/private deploy.

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cedarlane.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cedarlane.com>, Ameet Verma <ameet@cedarlane.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qual -> POC handshake: CedarLane pilot scope & kickoff actions

Karthik — thanks for the concise plan, this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Sample data: Priya will upload a de-identified CSV with ~500 rows by Friday (we can start with 250 representative rows).
- SSO: We prefer SAML SSO so we don’t have to manage separate API keys for our testers. I’ll ask our security team to send the IDP metadata.
- Success criteria: in addition to the 30% manual reduction, our internal goal is a 20% improvement in first-touch resolution rate — please add this as secondary metric.

We also have a short security questionnaire that needs a signature from your security contact. I attached it (security-qn-cust-signed.pdf) completed on our side; we’ll need a similar completed copy from Redwood for procurement.

Let’s tentatively target the kickoff for Monday 26 Oct — can you provision the workspace and add Marissa & Ben to the calendar invite?

Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product | CedarLane Health
sanjay@cedarlane.com | +1 617-555-2689

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Qual -> POC handshake: CedarLane pilot scope & kickoff actions

Karthik — forwarding my quick ops checklist for the pilot so we can pull the provisioning trigger once SSO metadata arrives. Feel free to paste into the kickoff invite.

--- ops checklist (for internal runbook) ---
- Create pilot project "cedarlane-pilot-DL-2026-1182" in Redwood Console.
- Add SAML config (IDP metadata) + test user group (cedar-pilot-testers).
- Provision two inference variants: 1) high-accuracy (quantized fp16) and 2) cost-optimized (8-bit) for A/B.
- Enable telemetry dashboards: token usage, latency p50/p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, eval results.
- Upload cedarlane success metric template and shared Drive links to project.
- Schedule perf window: target 500 concurrent short prompts (simulate triage load).

Attachments to include in kickoff: cedarlane-success-metrics.xlsx, perf-sim-runbook.md (we'll upload).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qual -> POC handshake: CedarLane pilot scope & kickoff actions

Sanjay / Priya — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming items:
- We received your signed questionnaire (thanks) and I’ve routed it to our security team — they’ll provide a counter-signed copy by Monday.
- Priya: noted for Friday on sample data upload. Please include a column mapping file if you can (helps our eval team).
- Ben: please proceed with creating the pilot project and SAML stub; Marissa will take ownership of the readout agenda.

I’ll send a 30-minute calendar invite for Monday 26 Oct at 10:00 AM ET for the kickoff (includes provisioning owners). Drive link with the plan and prompts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBCdExamplePilotPlan

Next steps checklist (short):
1) CedarLane: sample data + SAML metadata (by 23 Oct EOD).
2) Redwood: provision pilot project + upload metric template (by 25 Oct).
3) Joint kickoff: Mon 26 Oct 10:00 AM ET.

Look forward to getting started.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
